PROBE trade-mark search host robots: HTTP 200 at https://trademarks.ipo.gov.uk/robots.txt (observed 2026-10-07, standard pipeline UA) — the search application host walls keyless agents at robots.txt itself; nothing on that host was fetched beyond robots.txt. The gov.uk guidance pages remain the open surface.
Statutory fees are exact and on-page: "Registering a trade mark costs at least £205." A trade mark lasts 10 years and renewal cadence is stated alongside.
The identity wall on the patent filing path is a credential account, stated before you start: "You’ll need your One Login details if you have them, or you can set them up."
A paper fallback rail is published on the same page ("If you cannot file online" — fill in the request form for grant of a patent), so the online mandate has a documented alternative.
